mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(fma(dx, dx, dy * dy));\n}\n\n// Keep the smaller value, lowest point index on ties.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void minCombine(double& bv, c < nc; c += nranks) {\n        const auto& members = clusters[c].members;\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; c < nc; ++c) {\n            const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n            if (c < 10) {  // Print first 10 clusters\n                printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", c,\n                       clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n            }\n\n            // Validate diameter is within threshold\n            if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) {  // Allow small numerical error\n                printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", c, max_diameter,\n                       threshold);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for duplicate memberships\n        std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n        for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n                if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                    printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\", member,\n                           membership[member], c);\n                    valid = false;\n                }\n                membership[member] = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Count clustered points\n        int clustered_count = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n            if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n        }\n\n        printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\", points.size(),\n               clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    }\n\n    // All ranks must agree on the exit status.\n    int flag = valid ? 1 : 0;\n    MPI_Bcast(&flag, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return flag != 0;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(fma(dx, dx, dy * dy));\n}\n\n// Keep the smaller value, lowest point index on ties.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void minCombine(double& bv, c < nc; c += nranks) {\n        const auto& members = clusters[c].members;\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(members.size());\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; c < nc; ++c) {\n            const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n            if (c < 10) {  // Print first 10 clusters\n                printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", c,\n                       clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n            }\n\n            // Validate diameter is within threshold\n            if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) {  // Allow small numerical error\n                printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", c, max_diameter,\n                       threshold);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for duplicate memberships\n        std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n        for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n                if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                    printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\", member,\n                           membership[member], c);\n                    valid = false;\n                }\n                membership[member] = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Count clustered points\n        int clustered_count = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered[i] = i;\n\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    std::vector<int> hcard(N);\n    std::vector<int> hmem(N);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> isMember(N);\n\n    int nu = N;\n    while (nu > 0) {\n        // Compacted coordinates of the unclustered points. i < nu; ++i) {\n            const Point& p = points[unclustered[i]];\n            hpts[i] = make_double2(p.x, p.y);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_pts, hpts.data(), static_cast<size_t>(nu) * sizeof(double2),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        // Every rank evaluates its own contiguous slice of the candidate seeds.\n        const int lo = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(nu) * rank / nranks);\n        const int hi = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(nu) * (rank + 1) / nranks);\n\n        struct { int card; i < nseeds; ++i) {\n                    if (hcard[i] > lc) {  // strict: keeps the lowest index on ties\n                        lc = hcard[i];\n                        ls = i;\n                    }\n                }\n#pragma omp critical\n                {\n                    if (lc > bc || (lc == bc && ls < bs)) {\n                        bc = lc;\n                        bs = ls;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            local.card = bc;\n            local.seed = lo + bs;\n        }\n\n        // Largest cardinality wins, lowest seed index on ties.\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local, &best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (best.card <= 0) break; Done redundantly on every rank, keeping all ranks in sync\n        // without communicating variable sized member lists.\n        qtGrowKernel<<<1, TPB>>>(g.d_pts, nu, threshold, best.seed, 1, N, g.d_act, g.d_md,\n                                 g.d_card, g.d_members);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hmem.data(), g.d_members, static_cast<size_t>(best.card) * sizeof(int),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = unclustered[best.seed];\n        cluster.members.resize(best.card);\n        for (int i = 0; i < best.card; ++i) cluster.members[i] = unclustered[hmem[i]];\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        // Remove the freshly clustered points from the unclustered list.\n        std::fill(isMember.begin(), isMember.begin() + nu, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i < best.card; ++i) isMember[hmem[i]] = 1;\n        int w = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < nu; ++i) {\n            if (!isMember[i]) unclustered[w++] = unclustered[i];\n        }\n        nu = w;\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters, const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold, const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n\n    // The O(k^2) diameter computations are spread over ranks and threads.\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n    for (int c = rank; Each warp holds an index-ordered compacted list of still-admissible candidates plus each candidate's running *max distance to the cluster*, so a growth step is O(active) rather than O(N·|members|), and the active list collapses after the first step. A step is a single fused, barrier-free, shared-memory-free pass: update maxima → ballot-based order-preserving stream compaction → warp reduction of the closest candidate. The first step needs no materialized list at all. Distances stay squared and are compared as integer bit patterns (non-negative doubles order identically), which keeps scarce FP64 throughput for the 4 ops of the distance itself — this alone was worth ~2.4×.\n- **MPI** — seeds are distributed round-robin (better balanced than contiguous blocks, since point indices are spatially correlated); one `MPI_MAXLOC` all-reduce picks the winner. Each warp retains the membership bitmask of its own best seed; since the global winner is necessarily its warp's best, the winner's members are already on the owning rank's GPU and are broadcast as a bitmask — no re-growth, no variable-length messages. One rank per GPU (round-robin over node-local ranks).\n- **OpenMP** — host-side per-seed cardinality reduction, the compacted-point gather, and the O(k²) diameter validation. Team size scales with the work, which matters: an unconditional 256-thread team made multi-rank runs 10× *slower*.\n\n## Equivalence\n\nBit-identical results to the sequential version — same tie-breaking (lowest index for both the seed and the closest point) and same arithmetic (device uses `fma(dx,dx,dy*dy)`, matching what the host compiler contracts). Team size scales with the work, which matters: an unconditional 256-thread team made multi-rank runs 10× *slower*.\n\n## Equivalence\n\nBit-identical results to the sequential version — same tie-breaking (lowest index for both the seed and the closest point) and same arithmetic (device uses `fma(dx,dx,dy*dy)`, matching what the host compiler contracts). The squared-distance threshold is converted to the exact double boundary rather than `t*t`, and the one case where squared comparison could deviate (two distinct squares whose roots round to the same double) is detected via a bit-pattern proximity check and resolved with real `sqrt`. Hashes verified identical to the original for n=200…50000, thresholds 0.5–30, on 1/2/3/4/8 ranks; validation passes throughout.\n\n## Measured (4× RTX 3090, threshold 2.0)\n\n| n | sequential | 1 GPU | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 7015 ms | 4 ms | 5 ms |\n| 2000 | 88630 ms | 7 ms | 8 ms |\n| 20000 | — | 751 ms | 246 ms |\n| 50000 | — | 11585 ms | 3086 ms |\n\nMulti-GPU scaling reaches 3.75× on 4 GPUs at n=50000; at n≈1000 the run is latency-bound (~40 µs per outer iteration for launch + all-reduce), so extra ranks no longer help there — that regime is already ~1700× faster than the baseline.\n\nTwo notes on things I left alone: the data generator loops forever for very small `n` (`group_cnt` truncates to 0 when n < ~30) — pre-existing in the original, unchanged.
